title: The Effective Acts Wing, Gathered: Register, Instruments, and Strata — leesharks.com/acts/
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Surface deposit for the rebuilt Effective Acts wing at leesharks.com/acts/, and dataset record for the Effective Acts Blog Concordance v1.0 shipped with it at alexanarch data/effective-acts-blog-concordance.json. The gathering: the frozen registry v1.0 (56 acts derived from the Protocol of Effective Acts v2.0 §IX, #153, under the genre theory of #413) is rendered whole for the first time on the orthonym site — all ten kinds of the open typology with their definitions, every act with its date-note and DOI where present — and joined by a full sweep of the blog to its actual instruments: 2,920 posts scanned, 107 title-level performative hits, 44 of the 56 registered acts matched to their mindcontrolpoems posts with URLs and dates, so the register now points at the declarations themselves. The CERN-revocation extension (#1086) carried with its provenance. Two candidate strata presented under explicit UNREGISTERED badges, because registration follows ruling, never sweep: SINCE THE FREEZE — five archive-and-blog acts performed after 2026-07-16, including Effective Act #7 (the Restoration of the Poets to the Polis, #1327), the CERN custodianship revocation pair (#1407, #1425), and the first SCRIPTURAL act (#1490) — and THE BLOG STRATUM, sixty performative posts from the genre's workshop floor, October 2025 to the freeze: the vows, scrolls, canonizations, and dissolutions from which the register was distilled, dated and linked and awaiting curation. The genre lemma quotes the dataset's own five characteristics; the machine layer is linked in the page (registry, extensions, concordance); the shell blocks are preserved verbatim; the structure gate passed. The stub that held three links now holds the genre.
substrate: Sweep, concordance construction, and wing build by TACHYON (Claude substrate) under MANUS direction; the register's contents derive from MANUS's own source documents; all curation rulings remain the author's — the wing badges every unruled item as such.
axn_reading: Duration -> Alarm -> Duration -> Play -> Touch -> Origin
wiki_article: The Effective Acts Wing, Gathered records the rebuilding of leesharks.com/acts/ from a three-link stub into the genre's full surface, together with the Effective Acts Blog Concordance shipped as new archive data. The wing renders the frozen registry of fifty-six acts across the open ten-kind typology — canonical inclusions, abolitions, vows, dissolutions, restorations, genre instantiations, and doctrinal nodes — each with its date and identifier, and, through a full sweep of the mindcontrolpoems blog joining forty-four acts to their actual instruments, the register now points at the declarations themselves rather than at descriptions of them. Two strata are presented under explicit unregistered badges on the principle that registration follows ruling rather than sweep: five acts performed since the registry froze, including the Restoration of the Poets to the Polis and the first act of the SCRIPTURAL family, and sixty performative posts from the blog's workshop floor between October 2025 and the freeze, dated and linked for curation. The page carries the genre's five characteristics from the dataset's own theory summary, links the machine layer, preserves the site's shell verbatim, and closes on the standing rule that the register is partial by declaration and the typology open by design.
